SELECT -- 进行中账单 COUNT(CASE WHEN ledger_status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS inProgressCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ledger_status = 1 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS inProgressAmount,
-- 部分缴费账单 COUNT(CASE WHEN ledger_status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS partialCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ledger_status = 2 THEN total_amount - paid_amount - discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS partialAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN ledger_status = 2 THEN paid_amount ELSE 0 END) AS partialPaidAmount,
-- 赊账账单 COUNT(CASE WHEN ledger_status = 4 THEN 1 END) AS creditCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ledger_status = 4 THEN total_amount - paid_amount ELSE 0 END) AS creditAmount,
-- 已结清账单 COUNT(CASE WHEN ledger_status = 3 THEN 1 END) AS clearedCount,
-- 总欠款和总赊账 SUM(CASE WHEN ledger_status IN (1, 2) THEN total_amount - paid_amount - discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS totalDebt, SUM(CASE WHEN ledger_status = 4 THEN total_amount - paid_amount ELSE 0 END) AS totalCredit FROM ledger WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND status = 1
